source: LOCAL SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. No network request performed.

coverage.scope: one response; headers, cookie flags and hostname

findings.title: Missing strict-transport-security
findings.evidence: Not present in supplied response headers
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS after validating HTTPS across the service.

findings.title: Missing content-security-policy
findings.evidence: Not present in supplied response headers
findings.remediation: Define and test an application-specific Content Security Policy.

findings.title: Missing referrer-policy
findings.evidence: Not present in supplied response headers

findings.title: Missing permissions-policy
findings.evidence: Not present in supplied response headers
findings.remediation: Restrict unused browser capabilities with Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: No observed framing restriction
findings.evidence: Neither CSP frame-ancestors nor valid X-Frame-Options

findings.title: Technology banner exposed
findings.remediation: Minimize unnecessary version disclosure; confirm applicability before CVE matching.

limitations: Configuration observations only. A missing header is not proof of exploitation. Redirects and blocked/error pages do not assess the destination application.
